Amount 1E. Amount 1B, 1C or 1D, whichever is the least. Instance 1.
Amount 1F. Income eligible for Manitoba lower tax rate. Amount 1E multiplied by the result of taxable income for Manitoba divided by taxable income for all provinces.
Amount 1G. Income subject to Manitoba higher tax rate. Amount 1A minus amount 1F. Instance 1.

Amount 2C. Manitoba tax before credits. Amount 2A minus amount 2B.
